decision: spawned three design runners (fable, opus, gpt-5.6-sol) on the same contract

decision: picked fable's manifest plus content-addressed png as the base, grafted opus's header menu for login toggle and sol's logger
why: one atomic manifest holds order and source facts with the least sweep logic; the header menu is where the user already looks; log lines let the real app be verified from log show

decision: delegated implementation to gpt-5.6-sol via codex exec workspace-write, single owner
why: the store, monitor, view and tests share one data shape, so one implementer beats parallel workers

decision: confirmed the sRGB pixel hash is identical for the P3 screenshot file, its TIFF re-encode, and the pasteboard TIFF
why: the fable design flagged colour conversion as the one risk to same-image-once across sources

decision: wrote scripts/verify.sh: builds the bundle, ingests 4 files (3 identical), SIGKILLs, relaunches, checks the restore log line, ingests 12 more, checks eviction to 10 files, prints RSS at each point
why: the end-to-end proof has to be a script a reviewer can rerun, and it must not touch the user's Desktop or store
result: written, runs after the delegate lands

decision: delegate finished after a relaunch; first codex run was killed by the 10 minute tool timeout mid-edit, second run continued from the partial tree
why: codex has no time limit of its own, the Bash tool does; detached with nohup the second time

decision: found a 30 MB per image retention in the delegate's fingerprint: Data(bytes:count:) copy of the pixel buffer was kept alive; replaced with a bufferPointer update
why: heap showed one full size non-object buffer per ingest; harness on the real store went from 187 MB after 6 ingests to 5 MB

decision: replaced the delegate's TIFF promise (semaphore, detached task, NSObject conformance, main hop) with a 15 line TIFFPromise provider that reads the PNG file and encodes on demand
why: the pasteboard callback is synchronous by contract, so the actor round trip only added plumbing; the store directory is a let so the file URL is nonisolated

decision: thumbnails are now drawn into a 560 px context from the already decoded CGImage instead of a second ImageIO pass
why: removes the re-decode for editor output and 5 MB of ImageIO retention per 6 thumbnails

decision: scripts/verify.sh PASS on the built bundle: 3 identical plus 1 distinct file gave 2 entries, SIGKILL then relaunch logged restored 2 items, 12 more files evicted down to 10 pngs, footprint 14 MB idle, 15 MB after 14 ingests
why: the predicate is checked on the real app through the file system and log show, not a self report
